title: Tarski Fixed Point Theorem For Compact Euclidean Lattices
body_html:
Tarski Fixed Point Theorem For Compact Euclidean Lattices

Let $L$ be a compact nonempty lattice in $\mathbb R^n$ with the coordinatewise partial order. If $$ f:L\to L $$ is monotone, then $f$ has a fixed point.

Moreover, every nonempty subset of $L$ has a supremum and an infimum in $L$, so $L$ has a greatest and a smallest element.
